name: Sardis and the Lydian Tumuli of Bin Tepe
description: Sardis, in western Türkiye's Manisa Province, was the capital of the Lydians, an Iron Age kingdom famed for its wealth and early coinage. Its fortified walls and terraces still mark the old city. Nearby, on the shore of Lake Marmara, Bin Tepe ("a thousand mounds") holds over 100 grassy burial tumuli, some among the largest in the world, built for Lydian elites.
